title: [Annual Payment of Tls. 16,500 — Apportionment]
caption_extra: Letter of December 17, 1917 (Shanghai): 'the Company shall pay to the Council, commencing with the year 1917, the sum of Tls. 16,500 per annum made up as under:—' (clause (1), items (a) to (d) set in the prose, figures at right)

row_labels: (a) Maintenance and renewal of macadam and chip-paving on tramway tracks
(b) Maintenance and renewal of wood block paving on tramway tracks in Bund and Nanking Road
(c) A fixed payment in respect of maintenance and renewal of stone setts alongside rails
(d) A fixed payment to compound for any increase in rate of wear and tear of track surfaces due to possible increase of traffic, etc.

footnotes: The amounts (a) and (b) shall be subject to alteration in any year pro rata to any increase or decrease in the corresponding areas due to increase or decrease in the length of track.
